title: Consensus clustering via bipartite graph partition with adaptive anchor selection
target_sentence: Adaptive anchor selection strategies further enhance bipartite consensus efficiency across large instance sets (Guo et al.~\cite{guo2026consensus}).

title: Ensemble clustering with high-order consensus information
target_sentence: Recent ensemble clustering approaches increasingly incorporate high-order consensus information to capture multi-hop relations beyond pairwise co-occurrences (Zhang et al.~\cite{zhang2025highorder}).

title: Self-supervised feature selection for high-dimensional clustering
target_sentence: In high-dimensional domains, unsupervised and self-supervised feature selection has emerged as a necessary prerequisite to remove uninformative coordinates before similarity estimation (Li et al.~\cite{li2025selfsupervised}).

title: Robust spectral ensemble clustering with sparse representation
target_sentence: Sparse representation techniques have been integrated into spectral ensemble clustering to suppress noisy partition edges (Fan et al.~\cite{fan2026robust}).

title: High-dimensional biomedical clustering with stability selection and consensus
target_sentence: Biomedical cohort clustering under high feature-to-sample ratios requires explicit noise screening to avoid convergence on spurious clinical subtypes (Jahanian et al.~\cite{jahanian2026highdim}).

title: Optimal rates and trade-offs in high-dimensional clustering
target_sentence: Minimax theoretical analysis establishes that consistent cluster recovery in high dimensions requires feature signal-to-noise ratios scaling with ambient dimension (Zhang and Zhou~\cite{zhang2024optimal}).

title: Adaptive anchor-based consensus clustering for large-scale data
target_sentence: Scalable multi-view ensemble clustering leverages adaptive anchor bipartite graphs to accelerate consensus inference on massive datasets (Kong et al.~\cite{kong2026adaptive}).

title: Spectral ensemble clustering with doubly stochastic co-association matrix
target_sentence: Enforcing doubly stochastic normalization over the consensus affinity matrix eliminates vertex degree artifacts in spectral graph partitioning (Cai et al.~\cite{cai2025spectral}).

title: Auto-weighted Graph Reconstruction for efficient ensemble clustering
target_sentence: Auto-weighted graph reconstruction dynamically recalibrates base ensemble contributions according to partition reliability (Yang et al.~\cite{yang2025autoweighted}).

title: Multiview ensemble clustering of hypergraph p-Laplacian regularization with feature selection
target_sentence: Jointly optimizing feature selection with hypergraph p-Laplacian regularization improves ensemble robustness against distractor noise (Hu et al.~\cite{hu2024multiview}).

title: CCEGAN: Enhancing GAN clustering through contrastive clustering ensemble
target_sentence: Contrastive clustering ensembles have also been explored in generative deep architectures to regularize latent representations (Chen et al.~\cite{chen2025ccegan}).

title: Bayesian clustering of high-dimensional data via latent repulsive mixtures
target_sentence: Latent repulsive mixture models have been proposed to prevent over-clustering in high-dimensional genomic feature spaces (Lau et al.~\cite{lau2024bayesian}).

title: Co-regularized optimal high-order graph embedding for multi-view clustering
target_sentence: High-order graph embedding and co-regularization offer principled mechanisms to align multi-view cluster assignments (Wang et al.~\cite{wang2025coregularized}).

title: A Generic Framework for Fair Consensus Clustering in Streams
target_sentence: Streaming and inductive consensus frameworks have recently expanded toward fairness-constrained partition updates across continuous data flows (Chakraborty et al.~\cite{chakraborty2026generic}).
